## Meeting Purpose

[Discuss and plan improvements for a canteen management system, focusing on menu creation and worker assignments.](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=1.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [Implement a more robust menu creation process, including unique week/canteen combinations and a potential 3-week cycle](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=508.0)
  - [Rework worker assignments to simplify the process and include company/canteen affiliations directly in worker profiles](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=540.0)
  - [Create a dishes database to streamline meal selection and include dietary information and pricing](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=273.0)
  - [Prioritize core functionality while keeping future enhancements in mind (e.g., draft/publish system, mobile-friendly design)](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=429.0)

## Topics

### Menu Creation Enhancements

  - [Constrain week selection to current or future weeks only](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=85.0)
  - [Ensure unique combinations of week number, year, and canteen](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=119.0)
  - [Implement at least one dish per lunch and dinner for each day](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=171.0)
  - [Consider creating a separate menu entity that can be assigned to multiple canteens](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=223.0)
  - [Discuss potential 3-week menu cycle (needs clarification from stakeholders)](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=925.0)

### Meal Management

  - [Create a dishes database to store meal information](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=339.0)
  - [Include dietary group classifications (e.g., vegetarian) and pricing for each dish](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=247.0)
  - [Implement a search/select system for adding meals to menus](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=339.0)
  - [Allow for easy creation of new dishes within the menu creation process](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=356.0)

### Worker Management

  - [Rework worker assignments to simplify the process](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=568.0)
  - [Include company and canteen assignments directly in worker profiles](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=702.0)
  - [Remove the need for a separate assignments collection](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=735.0)
  - [Add functionality for managing sick leaves](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=401.0)

### User Interface Improvements

  - [Consider moving from popup dialogs to full pages for menu creation](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=1013.0)
  - [Implement filters for canteen selection in the admin interface](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=1083.0)
  - [Evaluate the need for a canteen profile page for menu creation](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=1105.0)

### Database Structure

  - [Create a dishes table to store meal information](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=339.0)
  - [Consider separating menu-canteen assignments into a new table](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=136.0)
  - [Add price information to meals for billing purposes](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=273.0)
  - [Evaluate the need for a roles collection vs. using profile information](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=1306.0)

  - [Clarify the 3-week menu cycle concept with stakeholders](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=925.0)
  - [Continue refining the UI, focusing on core functionality before adding advanced features](https://fathom.video/share/sPG2wT2PyCcB2iJGLpXmyQsMm8S8EpMR?tab=summary&timestamp=429.0)
